question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

Scold
solution:
The correct answer is- **"Praise"**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In the given options, **"praise"** is the most appropriate antonym of Scold.
 
• The word** "Scold" **means - to rant at someone because they did something wrong or nasty.
 
 
• **Example:** The teacher scolded the student because he was fighting in the class.
 
 
 
• While the word **"Praise"** means- to express admiration for somebody/something.
 
 
• **Example:** he soldiers were **praised **for their brave-heart sacrifices that they made.
 
 
 
• Thus, ***option 2)*** is the correct alternative.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** Let us understand the meaning of other options.

 
• **Nag:** repeatedly criticising someone's actions or asking action from them.

 
 
• **Example:** Her mother keeps nagging him to clean up her room.
 
 
 
• **Avoid:** to keep away
 
 
• **Example:** She avoids her relatives because they keep on insulting her.
